mapper.select: select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, c2.C_Name as secTendereeName, c2.C_Abbreviation as secTendereeAbbName, c3.C_Name as sprCompanyName, c3.C_Abbreviation as sprCompanyAbbName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, sit.Sit_Scope as sitScope, spr.* from Sec_Price_Resultsf spr left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=spr.Sec_Id left join Sec_Inquiry_Team sit on sit.Sec_Id=spr.Sec_Id and sit.Sit_Id=(select Sit_Id from Sec_Inquiry_Team where Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id and State=7 order by State_Time desc limit 1) left join SYS_Company c2 on sec.Sec_Tenderee=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on spr.Spr_Company=c3.C_Id left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_Id=sec.Sec_Agency where spr.Spr_Id=#{sprId}
